verdict.rationale: AMD's official docs confirm ROCm/Instinct stack is Linux-first (cross-platform Linux/Windows) with extensive Linux-oriented tooling (AMD SMI, Validation Suite, Container Toolkit, GPU Operator) and independent community benchmarking (chipsandcheese, HN) exercises the MI355X, implicitly on Linux since ROCm's primary supported OS is Linux. However, no explicit dated Linux driver release notes/changelog or independent report explicitly confirming Linux driver testing is present. Missing for 10: versioned Linux driver release notes/changelog, explicit independent Linux-specific driver validation report.
